note: The script asks for the hook text, the name super, three number pops (50th → 58th, 12 to 14 days, 2 hours) and one key line (gold standard). The other rows are captions only. The end card is typed until the LearnFresh logo is in the repo.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: 50th to 58th percentile. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: David McKinney / Senior Research Associate, WestEd.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: 50th to 58th percentile. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: David McKinney / Senior Research Associate, WestEd.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Senior Research Associate, WestEd> under it.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop on “58th”: 50th → 58th, label percentile. Top band, 2 s.
mg.use: Pop it at the moment he says “58th” as it is said, top band, 2 s.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop as he says it: 12 to 14 days. Top band, 2 s.
mg.use: Pop it at the moment he says “12 to 14 days” as it is said, top band, 2 s.

mg.title: Key line
mg.cue: Key line in the top band as he says it: gold standard. 2 s.
mg.use: Put it on at the moment he says it and hold 2 s, in the top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop as he says it: 2 hours, label of training. Top band, 2 s.
mg.use: Pop it at the moment he says “two hours of training” as it is said, top band, 2 s.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card lines: <q>Read the full study</q>. No logo before this card.
mg.src: No LearnFresh logo file in the repo yet (brand kit is in Airtable). The name is typed until the logo is added to endcards/learn-fresh/.
